content.description: Complete replacement working memory governed by the thought purpose. Update the existing thought with new observations and retain relevant facts, exact identifiers and their associations, and unresolved conditions.

summary.description: Brief evidence-based account of what the latest act established or changed.

outcome.description: Latest act only. SUCCEEDED completed its objective, PARTIAL left actionable work, BLOCKED awaits a prerequisite, NOOP needed no action, and FAILED did not accomplish its objective.

durableProgress.description: True when the latest act made a verified durable change, completed a handoff, or produced a new test result. False for reads, including first-time verification of readiness.

confidence.description: Confidence in the latest act evaluation, for telemetry.
